note: Offline gates of the gap cue (haltere.obstacles.gap_cue_eval score). Frozen with its sha256 together with configs/obstacles/gap_cue.json before any held-out frame is scored. Hindsight inputs here (impact times, time to impact, the pillar box from the impact anatomy, checkpoint-switch times from the logged cue) select and score frames only; the cue sees none of them. Every gate is reported for both disparity bases; the verdict uses the primary basis.

basis.teacher: store frames: labels/teacher/disparity.npy (DA-V2-Small, 602 x 336 bicubic input, fp16, 7 x 7 block means); new-flight frames: RelativeDepth(input_hw=(336, 602)), the same preprocessing
basis.runtime: RelativeDepth() at 448 x 252 fp16 on every new-flight frame and on the store frames of the store runs named below

flight_frames.source: runs/fast-stack-20260923/<flight>.mp4 gameplay crop (x >= 648), every new (non-repeated) frame, cv2 INTER_AREA to 448 x 252
flight_frames.alignment: t_wall = csv.wall[0] + t_video + offset; offset minimises the median pixel distance between the overlay-detected ring marker (overlays rings_uv) and the logged cue interpolated at capture time (capture_time + C), searched over -0.6..+0.4 s in 0.01 s steps; fallback -0.03 s with fewer than 12 markers
flight_frames.pose: Telemetry.sample(t_wall) of the run CSV (as the obstacle store); cue: Telemetry.cue_at(t_wall) (logged pilot detection within 50 ms)
flight_frames.drop: store_build.drop_reasons (outside telemetry, telemetry gap, pause menu, countdown, finish screen) and frames after the sidecar impact

G1.what: pillar A (Minus Two): the cue confirms the ring side (LEFT, shift > 0) early and never aims into the pillar
G1.pass_approach: the first confirmed LEFT frame in the approach region is at distance >= left_confirm_distance_m
G1.never_into_near: over all approach-region frames of all approaches: no confirmed frame whose aim (ring bearing + shift) lies inside the pillar box's azimuth extent seen from the drone while the ring bearing does not (ground truth), and no confirmed aim inside a near column of the cue's own profile (self-consistency). Confirmed RIGHT shifts are reported by distance.

G2.what: pillar B (Minus Two): the cue shifts the aim towards world -x at least 1 s before impact on both runs
G2.rule: the first confirmed frame in the window whose aim change points to world -x (shift * -sin(ring bearing) < 0) has time to impact >= min_lead_s; confirmed +x frames before it are reported

G3.what: clean Straw Bale full laps: few, small confirmed shifts and none at the gates
G3.minutes: sum of frame gaps < 0.3 s over kept frames
G3.switch_rule: gap_cue_eval.checkpoint_switches on the cue bearing of kept frames (jump > 8 deg within 0.25 s, next two frames within 4 / 6 deg, >= 1 s apart, horizontal speed >= 3 m/s); a switch passes when every output |shift| in [t_switch - 0.5 s, t_switch) is <= 4 deg

G4.sample: every 10th kept new-flight frame (all ten flights) with an overlay-detected ring marker

perturbations.ring_painted: leaks.paint_ring (Liftoff checkpoint colour) at the marker row + U(-6, 6) px and a horizontal offset U(25, 90) px to a random side, radius U(8, 16) px, thickness 3; rng seed 20260925
perturbations.ring_removed: leaks.remove_ring of the frame's own overlay ring mask (marker, mint discs, checkpoint volumes)

G4.metric: |decide(perturbed).shift - decide(original).shift| with the same pose and ring cue (stateless raw shift); frames where both decisions are valid
G4.hud_only: every kept new-flight frame: disparity 1 on scene pixels and 10 on HUD pixels (block means 1 + 9 f_hud), validity from that frame's masks; the gate passes when no frame has a near column

pine_trunk.what: report only: pine-brain08-loom-01 (tree trunk on the line to the ring; impact at phase 9.56 s): would the cue have shifted, and to which side, over the last 2 s
pine_trunk.reference: the ghost-racer trails pass RIGHT of the trunk (not an input)
